description: Fresh random sample from entire course - independent verification round
scoring_criteria: Portuguese grammar (subjunctive, gender, contractions), naturalness, pedagogical value

worst_phrases.issue: CRITICAL: Missing subjunctive after 'quero que' / 'gostaria que'. Must be 'que você ajude' (present subjunctive) or 'que você ajudasse' (imperfect subjunctive). This is a fundamental Portuguese grammar rule - infinitive is never used after 'que' in subordinate clauses requiring subjunctive.

worst_phrases.english: that would be less exciting than I thought earlier
worst_phrases.other: isso seria menos emocionante do que eu achei que antes
worst_phrases.issue: Garbled phrase structure. 'do que eu achei que antes' is nonsensical - 'que' is duplicated incorrectly. Should be 'do que eu achava antes' or 'do que eu pensei antes'. The phrase is essentially broken.

worst_phrases.english: but you want to meet with everyone else later on
worst_phrases.other: mas você quer nos encontrar com todos os outros mais tarde
worst_phrases.issue: Incorrect reflexive pronoun. 'nos encontrar' means 'to meet us' - conflicting with 'com todos os outros'. Should be 'quer se encontrar com todos os outros' (reflexive) or 'quer encontrar todos os outros' (transitive).

worst_phrases.english: I think she needs to come and help us
worst_phrases.other: eu acho que ela precisa vir e ajudar nós
worst_phrases.issue: Object pronoun placement error. 'ajudar nós' is incorrect - should be 'nos ajudar' (proclisis) or 'ajudar-nos' (enclisis). Portuguese object pronouns cannot follow the verb in this position without hyphenation.

systematic_issues.description: One phrase uses infinitive where subjunctive is required after 'gostaria que'. This is a fundamental Portuguese grammar rule.
Pronoun 'nós' used in object position without proper clitic form. Portuguese requires 'nos' as object pronoun with specific placement rules.
Some phrases end with prepositions in a way that reflects English structure rather than natural Portuguese.
Phrase 5 uses 'jogar' which typically means playing games/sports, not playing music or general activity.

phrases.english: I met someone who said that he wanted to tell you something before the weekend
phrases.other: eu conheci alguém que disse que ele queria te dizer algo antes do fim de semana
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Natural phrasing. Minor redundancy with 'ele' after 'que disse' but acceptable in spoken Portuguese.

phrases.english: thank you very much, but I've got more to learn
phrases.other: muito obrigado, mas eu tenho mais a aprender
phrases.qa_notes: Good. 'muito obrigado' is masculine form - correct if speaker is male. Grammar is correct.

phrases.english: my father doesn't like to stop talking but my mother likes to read
phrases.other: meu pai não gosta de parar de falar mas minha mãe gosta de ler
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct possessive agreement (meu pai, minha mãe). Natural phrase structure.

phrases.english: my mother wants to understand what he was saying on Sunday afternoon
phrases.other: a minha mãe quer entender o que ele estava dizendo no domingo à tarde
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. 'a minha mãe' is European Portuguese style, also valid in Brazil. 'no domingo à tarde' is correct.

phrases.english: I should consider playing something else when I'm ready
phrases.other: eu deveria considerar jogar outra coisa quando eu estou pronto
phrases.qa_notes: Issues: 1) 'quando eu estou' should be 'quando eu estiver' (future subjunctive). 2) 'jogar' typically for games/sports - 'tocar' for instruments, or broader verb needed.

phrases.english: everything today
phrases.other: tudo hoje
phrases.qa_notes: Grammatically correct fragment. Low pedagogical value as standalone phrase.

phrases.english: I started to think about it last month
phrases.other: eu comecei a pensar nisso no mês passado
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. 'nisso' (em+isso) correct contraction. 'no mês passado' natural time expression.

phrases.english: I know a young man who would give you an answer if he could
phrases.other: eu conheço um homem jovem que te daria uma resposta se ele pudesse
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Conditional 'daria' and imperfect subjunctive 'pudesse' correctly paired. 'homem jovem' works though 'jovem homem' is also natural.

phrases.english: that would be less exciting than I thought earlier
phrases.other: isso seria menos emocionante do que eu achei que antes
phrases.qa_notes: POOR: 'do que eu achei que antes' is garbled/nonsensical. Double 'que' is incorrect. Should be 'do que eu achava antes' or 'do que eu pensei antes'.

phrases.english: the latest idea is to go tomorrow night at the office
phrases.other: a última ideia é ir amanhã à noite no escritório
phrases.qa_notes: Functional. 'ir no escritório' is slightly awkward - 'ir ao escritório' more natural for 'go to the office'.

phrases.english: I'm going to practise speaking with someone else
phrases.other: eu vou praticar falar com outra pessoa
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Natural construction with 'ir + infinitive' for near future.

phrases.english: I'm very happy with how much you could understand if you take time
phrases.other: eu estou muito feliz com o quanto você poderia entender se você tirar tempo
phrases.qa_notes: 'tirar tempo' is unusual - more natural: 'se você tiver tempo' (have time) or 'se você dedicar tempo' (dedicate time). Conditional logic also slightly off.

phrases.english: I can't remember how to say what I wanted to say this morning
phrases.other: eu não consigo lembrar como dizer o que eu queria dizer esta manhã
phrases.qa_notes: Good. 'não consigo lembrar' is natural for 'can't remember'. Correct structure.

phrases.english: he wants to find out why I don't like taking too much time to go
phrases.other: ele quer descobrir por que eu não gosto de levar muito tempo para ir
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. 'por que' (why) correctly written as two words. Natural flow.

phrases.english: he wanted to write a letter today because I think it's a good thing
phrases.other: ele queria escrever uma carta hoje porque eu acho que é uma coisa boa
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct imperfect 'queria'. Logical structure maintained.

phrases.english: can you understand Portuguese
phrases.other: você consegue entender português
phrases.qa_notes: Good. 'consegue entender' is natural for ability. Question intonation implied.

phrases.english: that we need to do this today
phrases.other: que nós precisamos fazer isso hoje
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct subordinate clause. 'nós precisamos' explicit subject acceptable.

phrases.english: there are too many ideas going around in my head and I need to think
phrases.other: há muitas ideias girando na minha cabeça e eu preciso pensar
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. 'há muitas ideias girando' is natural and idiomatic. Good imagery.

phrases.english: I've forgotten what you needed to help you with
phrases.other: eu esqueci o que você precisava que eu te ajudasse com
phrases.qa_notes: Functional but awkward ending with 'com'. Preposition stranding is English pattern. Better: 'com o que você precisava que eu te ajudasse'.

phrases.english: those are people that I don't know but I want to learn about
phrases.other: essas são pessoas que eu não conheço mas eu quero aprender sobre
phrases.qa_notes: Functional but dangling 'sobre' reflects English structure. More natural: 'sobre quem eu quero aprender'.

phrases.english: it wasn't possible to learn Portuguese quickly
phrases.other: não foi possível aprender português rápido
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Natural impersonal construction. 'rápido' as adverb is colloquial but acceptable.

phrases.english: he's just finished
phrases.other: ele acabou de terminar
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. 'acabou de + infinitive' is perfect for 'just finished'.

phrases.english: I'm not trying because I don't worry about making mistakes
phrases.other: eu não estou tentando porque eu não me preocupo em cometer erros
phrases.qa_notes: Good. 'preocupar-se em' is correct. Continuous 'estou tentando' appropriate.

phrases.english: she needs more time to learn
phrases.other: ela precisa de mais tempo para aprender
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Perfect structure. 'precisar de' correctly used.

phrases.english: she said that word in Portuguese
phrases.other: ela disse essa palavra em português
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Correct demonstrative 'essa'. Natural phrase.

phrases.english: to use your car today
phrases.other: usar o seu carro hoje
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct infinitive construction with possessive.

phrases.english: she said the restaurant was complete rubbish for her
phrases.other: ela disse que o restaurante era um lixo completo para ela
phrases.qa_notes: Good. 'um lixo completo' is colloquial but natural for strong negative opinion.

phrases.english: a bit of television at the weekend
phrases.other: um pouco de televisão no fim de semana
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct quantifier phrase. Natural time expression.

phrases.english: I thought the film was not what I wanted to see yesterday
phrases.other: eu achei que o filme não era o que eu queria ver ontem
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct tense sequence (achei/era/queria). Natural structure.

phrases.english: do you want to speak Portuguese with me?
phrases.other: você quer falar português comigo?
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Perfect conversational question. Natural Portuguese.

phrases.english: they want to do this today
phrases.other: eles querem fazer isso hoje
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Simple, correct, natural.

phrases.english: that man has just started to tell me something new
phrases.other: aquele homem acabou de começar a me dizer algo novo
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. 'acabou de começar' correctly chains recent past with infinitive.

phrases.english: don't want to find out
phrases.other: não quero descobrir
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Simple, correct. Implied first person subject.

phrases.english: I'd like you to help
phrases.other: eu gostaria que você ajudar
phrases.qa_notes: CRITICAL ERROR: Infinitive 'ajudar' after 'que' is WRONG. MUST use subjunctive: 'que você ajude' (present) or 'que você ajudasse' (imperfect). This is a fundamental Portuguese grammar rule.

phrases.english: I started learning last month and I still cannot think quickly
phrases.other: eu comecei a aprender no mês passado e eu ainda não consigo pensar rápido
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Long but grammatically correct. Natural progression of ideas.

phrases.english: but you want to meet with everyone else later on
phrases.other: mas você quer nos encontrar com todos os outros mais tarde
phrases.qa_notes: ERROR: 'nos encontrar' means 'meet us' - conflicting with 'com todos os outros'. Should be 'se encontrar com' (reflexive) or just 'encontrar'.

phrases.english: you want to come back
phrases.other: você quer voltar
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Simple, correct, natural.

phrases.english: I want to read the story
phrases.other: eu quero ler a história
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Natural, correct. Good pedagogical phrase.

phrases.english: I think she needs to come and help us
phrases.other: eu acho que ela precisa vir e ajudar nós
phrases.qa_notes: ERROR: 'ajudar nós' is incorrect pronoun placement. Must be 'nos ajudar' (proclisis) or 'ajudar-nos' (enclisis). Object pronouns cannot directly follow verb without hyphen.

phrases.english: we hoped to see the answer
phrases.other: nós esperávamos ver a resposta
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct imperfect 'esperávamos' for 'hoped'.

phrases.english: I don't know who that is
phrases.other: eu não sei quem é esse
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Natural question/statement structure.

phrases.english: a little more slowly
phrases.other: um pouco mais devagar
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Perfect phrase for learner use. Natural Portuguese.

phrases.english: I think it's the same thing that she was trying to do here now
phrases.other: eu acho que é a mesma coisa que ela estava tentando fazer aqui agora
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Complex sentence correctly structured. Natural flow.

phrases.english: I believe that this work is changing
phrases.other: eu acredito que este trabalho está mudando
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Correct use of demonstrative 'este'. Present progressive appropriate.

phrases.english: I know an old woman who can remember the answer and would help you
phrases.other: eu conheço uma mulher velha que consegue lembrar da resposta e te ajudaria
phrases.qa_notes: Good. 'mulher velha' is direct but grammatically correct. 'mulher idosa' would be more respectful but this is valid.

phrases.english: do you mind helping
phrases.other: você se importa em ajudar
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. 'importar-se em' is the correct construction. Natural request form.

phrases.english: you don't mind if it isn't easy
phrases.other: você não se importa se não é fácil
phrases.qa_notes: Good. Correct conditional construction.

phrases.english: I've learnt Portuguese already
phrases.other: eu já aprendi português
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Correct perfect tense. 'já' placement natural.

phrases.english: I'm not sure if I can guess what's going to happen today
phrases.other: não tenho certeza se eu consigo adivinhar o que vai acontecer hoje
phrases.qa_notes: Good. 'não tenho certeza' is natural for 'I'm not sure'. Correct structure.

phrases.english: he wants to find out why I'm not going to be able to learn easily
phrases.other: ele quer descobrir por que eu não vou conseguir aprender facilmente
phrases.qa_notes: Strong. Complex sentence correctly structured. 'ir + conseguir' appropriate for future ability.
